name: Spondyloepimetaphyseal Dysplasia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiographic Diagnostic Criteria for Spondyloepimetaphyseal Dysplasia

criteria.description: Presence of disproportionate short stature with short trunk
Radiographic evidence of abnormalities in spine, epiphyses, and metaphyses
Identification of pathogenic variants in COL2A1 or other related genes
Additional clinical features such as joint laxity, scoliosis, or early-onset osteoarthritis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Disproportionate short stature with characteristic radiographic changes in spine, epiphyses, and metaphyses; genetic confirmation supportive but not mandatory
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic heterogeneity exists; clinical and radiographic correlation is essential

pathognomonic.symptomName: Epiphyseal and metaphyseal dysplasia on imaging

occasional.symptomName: Respiratory complications due to thoracic deformity

laboratory: Normal routine laboratory tests; no specific biochemical markers
imaging: Coxa vara and other femoral deformities on X-ray
genetic: Pathogenic variants in COL2A1 gene (most common)
Other gene mutations related to collagen type II biosynthesis
other: Clinical assessment of disproportionate short stature and joint laxity

distinguishingFeatures: Short limb dwarfism rather than short trunk
Different radiographic features (e.g., narrowed interpedicular distances)
Predominant metaphyseal abnormalities without significant spinal involvement
Usually normal stature or mild short stature

redFlags: Progressive neurological deficits due to spinal cord compression
Severe respiratory compromise from thoracic deformity
Rapidly worsening scoliosis or spinal instability
references: Superti-Furga A, Unger S. Spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasias. In: GeneReviews® [Internet]. University of Washington, Seattle; 2020.
Spranger J, et al. Bone Dysplasias: An Atlas of Genetic Disorders of Skeletal Development. 3rd ed. Oxford University Press; 2012.
Warman ML, et al. A nosology and classification of genetic skeletal disorders: 2010 revision. Am J Med Genet A. 2011;155A(5):943-968.
